facts: A v0.3 Digest512 is sixteen canonical big-endian BabyBear u32 limbs.
The public order is scope, root, nullifier hash, payout digest.
The pool address is the statement consumer and is bound through scope.
A layout change requires a new selector, codec/layout version, statement domain, and parameter manifest.
Static ABI array elements each occupy one 32-byte ABI word regardless of uint32 width.

nonClaims: SHA-512 is not a proposed algebraic statement hash.
Oracle outputs are u32 chunks, not claimed canonical candidate field elements.
Mutation rejection demonstrates dependency coverage, not collision resistance or proof-system soundness.
checkerModel.parameterHandling: The common corpus intentionally omits candidate parameter IDs; the checker injects an explicit abstract parameter-domain token and mutates it to test scope binding.

measurementPolicy.exact: Only checked-in constants, source-level counts, and fixed-width byte arithmetic.
measurementPolicy.projected: All changed-AIR constraints/columns/performance, calldata gas, and unimplemented layout behavior.

securityScope: No security, audit, leakage, deployment, or public-network qualification is conferred.
